note: v4, written: EXPOSURE becomes a melody with a shape. The tenor's song no longer picks a colour tone at random each bar: every bar makes the same gesture - a leap of a fourth up into the chord's 9th, held across the 11/8 - and the sequence carries it down the changes (C#5-F#5 over Emaj9, A#4-D#5 over C#m11, F#4-B4 over Amaj9#11, D#4-G#4 over F#m9 ...), so the line falls in one recognisable shape while the harmony turns under it; the return replays it with the full band. compscore seeds 0/11/19/29 (guardrail): v3 95.036/96.016/95.846/96.313 (re-measured today) -> v4 96.639/97.178/95.684/96.785 (barvariety's anchor 0.465 -> 0.482: the sequence gives the bars something to recur).
